needs_atom.missing: 'Whenever a creature you control becomes the target of a spell, ...': TargetingEvent has only filter (the targeted object) and actor (the targeting object's controller), so it cannot say the targeting object is a SPELL. TargetingEvent(filter=creature you control) would also trigger on activated and triggered abilities (stronger than printed). Needed: a filter over the targeting object itself on TargetingEvent (e.g. a 'by' slot taking FAtom(STACK_KIND_EQ, 'SPELL'), whose vocabulary already exists). The rest maps: 'Hydra spells you cast cost {4} less to cast.' = CostModifier(SUBTYPE_EQ Hydra, YOU, CostDeltaReduceGeneric 4) as Watcher of the Spheres; 'Gargos fights up to one target creature you don't control' = FIGHT with Primal Might's QAtMost(1) target, attacker = the source.
